note: Frozen BEFORE supplementary real calls. v2.1 scoring is the ONLY quality metric. Q_min=0.80 unchanged.

distribution_finding.implication: E1 normal estimator NOT supported; use lognormal/empirical per cell
distribution_finding.estimator_rule: LOGNORM -> lognormal params; EMPIRICAL -> empirical CDF; NORM unused

task_selection.selection: Random(42) from disjoint pool; same 20 tasks across configs for pairing

call_budget.base: 5 configs x 2 conditions x 20 tasks x 4 nodes = 800
call_budget.recovery_extra: fault conditions only; worst case 300, realistic 200

quality_metric.primary: P(task correct | config, condition) via v2.1 scoring
quality_metric.Q_min_usage: validate 0.80 is reasonable; NEVER adjust Q_min based on results

termination: stop on any cap; model failure retry once then skip task
uncertainty: 20 tasks: 85%=17/20 (CI 64-95%), 60%=12/20 (CI 39-78%); overlapping CIs; initial calibration ONLY
